categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in metal materials testing technology, offering services and products including third-party testing services, testing and analysis instruments, standard substances/samples, proficiency testing services, corrosion protection engineering and products, and other extended testing services. These services cater to industries such as steel, metallurgy, non-ferrous metals, machinery, aerospace, high-speed rail, nuclear power, automotive, new materials, environment, food, and petrochemicals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced scientific methods and professional technologies for physical, chemical, mechanical, non-destructive, corrosion, and calibration testing. It develops and manufactures a wide range of testing instruments including direct-reading spectrometers, gas element analyzers, X-ray fluorescence spectrometers, ICP spectrometers, ICP-MS mass spectrometers, scanning electron microscopes, material testing machines, and non-destructive testing equipment. The company emphasizes independent intellectual property and innovation in instrument development and testing methodologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span traditional heavy industries such as steel, metallurgy, and machinery, as well as emerging sectors like aerospace, high-speed rail, automotive manufacturing, new materials, environmental protection, food safety, and petrochemicals. The company serves government bodies, industry associations, quality inspection agencies, enterprises, and laboratories requiring authoritative metal material testing and evaluation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with a nationwide laboratory network including locations in Beijing, Qingdao, Shenyang, Deyang, Xi'an, Zhuzhou, and Zhuozhou. It also has overseas operations, including a subsidiary in Germany. Domestic revenue accounts for over 98% of total revenue, with limited international sales primarily to Belt and Road countries such as Indonesia, India, and Turkey.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and upstream segments of the testing industry supply chain. It provides testing services (midstream), manufactures testing instruments and standard substances (upstream), and offers proficiency testing and corrosion protection services, thus covering multiple points in the testing and quality assurance supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include leading material industry quality infrastructure construction, supporting national strategic needs, and serving the entire material industry chain with comprehensive quality solutions. The company focuses on digital transformation, enhancing instrument quality, expanding product certification, and strengthening talent development. R&D efforts target advanced testing instruments, digital and intelligent testing technologies, and new material evaluation methods, with significant investment in innovation and patent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through fees for third-party testing services, sales of testing and analysis instruments, sales of standard substances/samples, proficiency testing services, and corrosion protection engineering and products. Pricing is generally cost-plus, considering material costs, labor, manufacturing overhead, market conditions, and brand value. Payment terms vary by business segment, including upfront payments, framework agreements, and periodic settlements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading authoritative testing institution in China's steel and metal materials testing sector, recognized for comprehensive service categories and strong technical capabilities. It holds numerous national-level testing centers and innovation platforms, with high international recognition and certifications. It competes with other domestic and international testing service providers and instrument manufacturers, maintaining a strong market position through technological leadership and broad industry penetration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.1 billion, a 15.6% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 145 million, up 15.37%. Total assets reached RMB 2.09 billion, growing 11.46%, and equity attributable to shareholders was RMB 1.19 billion, up 12.75%. The company shows steady growth in revenue, profitability, and cash flow, supported by expanding laboratory capacity and product sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its authoritative brand and credibility in metal materials testing, backed by national-level testing centers and certifications. It offers comprehensive testing services with high technical standards and innovation, including proprietary instruments and advanced testing methodologies. Its integrated service model reduces customer management costs and communication barriers, providing one-stop solutions across multiple testing needs. The company also focuses on digital transformation and intelligent testing to enhance service quality and efficiency.
